title: Governor Of Bengal
definition: The Governor of Bengal was a premier executive office established by the British East India Company following the Battle of Plassey (1757) and Battle of Buxar (1764), which later evolved into the Governor-General of Bengal under the Regulating Act of 1773.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial foundational microtopic for Modern Indian History (GS Paper 1) and Constitutional Development (GS Paper 2), tracing the administrative evolution from a purely commercial trading post to a centralized imperial government.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Governor Of Bengal.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
